summary: For each spend_date, classify each user as mobile-only, desktop-only, or both, based on the platforms they spent on that date. tieRules: Each user belongs to exactly one category per date.
edgeRules: A date with no mobile-only users still returns the mobile row with total_amount 0 and total_users 0.
